sn38.9:1.3: yaṃ kho āvuso dukkhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhasamudaye aññāṇaṃ, dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ,
sn38.9:1.5: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā, etissā avijjāya pahānāyāti.
sn38.9:1.6: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāyāti.
sn38.9:1.7: katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāyāti.
sn38.9:1.8: ayameva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etissā avijjāya pahānāya. seyyathidaṃ:
sn38.9:1.10: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāyāti.
sn38.9:1.11: bhaddako āvuso maggo, bhaddikā paṭipadā etissā avijjāya pahānāya.
